# Kids Gardening

> > Kids Gardening inspires and educates children to grow plants, discover nature, and build community through gardening programs, resources, and partnerships with botanical gardens and educational organizations.

Kids Gardening is a comprehensive platform dedicated to youth gardening education, featuring community forums, school garden initiatives, early childhood programs, and partnerships with major botanical gardens and entertainment brands like DreamWorks Animation. The organization supports educators, parents, and young gardeners through resources, grants, and networking opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Youth Gardening
- Kids Garden Community
- School Gardens
- Early Childhood Gardening
- Community Networking

- Kids Events
